Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Content-only extraction metadata policy over canonical TAR/ZIP entries: regular files/directories, DOS0/Unix3 creator attributes, explicit type consistency and a narrow validated ignored-extra allowlist. Names remain raw canonical archive bytes; Unicode alternatives do not replace them. Four native groups pass 222 authored cases (TAR18, ZIP84, extras108, bounds/strides12). This allocation-free classifier performs no filesystem operation, namespace planning, ownership/permission restoration or ZIP payload CRC/decode validation; physical borrowed backing remains the caller's obligation.
